verdict.rationale: Mastra is a framework for building agents, and a framework could plausibly ship an in-product assistant, so this axis applies. However, the evidence shows only developer building blocks: a scaffolding command that generates an agent harness, and Studio, which is for building and testing your own agents. Neither is a built-in AI assistant to which a user can delegate tasks inside the product, so this is adjacent support and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Run this command to create a general-purpose agent harness with a local workspace, shell tools, memory, task tracking, web access, and recurring schedules.
